The '''Slicer Sprint''' was a regular competition among [[Slicer/Legends|slicers]]. During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the target of one cycle's Slicer Sprint was the headquarters mainframe of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Slicing|Fast as You Can}}</ref>
